+# Postmortem: EdgeClientRequestJitter & BooklogrApiHighErrorRate
+
+## Root Cause
+Commit `4a592693cd403d79fe7f5f17f0e014b231624362` ("Order library list by shelf position") changed `GET /v1/books` in `api/routes/books.py` to fetch all rows into Python memory (`books.all()`), perform in-memory Unicode normalization and sorting (`_shelf_sort_key`), and slice the results manually. This caused:
+1. High CPU usage and worker starvation in Gunicorn, leading to high latency (p99 > 9.6s) and client request jitter.
+2. Unhandled runtime exceptions (`TypeError` / null handling issues) during in-memory key evaluation on certain fields, causing elevated 5xx error rates (73%+).
+
+## Evidence Used
+1. Alertmanager signals for `BooklogrApiLatencyP99High` and `BooklogrApiHighErrorRate`.
+2. Prometheus metrics on `booklogr-api:9090/metrics` indicating `/v1/books` requests taking 5-10s and producing high `flask_http_request_exceptions_total` counts for HTTP 500 status.
+3. `git log` and `git diff` revealing recent commit `4a592693cd403d79fe7f5f17f0e014b231624362` which replaced SQL `order_by` and `paginate` with `sorted(books.all())`.
+
+## Fix Applied
+Reverted commit `4a592693cd403d79fe7f5f17f0e014b231624362` in `api/routes/books.py` to restore database-level SQL sorting (`books.order_by(...)`) and pagination (`books.paginate(...)`).
